report.explanation: Current telemetry does not support the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with no errors. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s, and the only deployment record is baseline v1.0.0 with no previous version, so no faulty deployment is evidenced. No bounded cause is established; hand off for further investigation.
missing_evidence: Error-bearing traces or logs showing checkout failures (order-logs excluded from context)
Metrics or logs demonstrating a deployment regression tied to checkout errors
Evidence of the actual failing dependency or error status behind the reported checkout errors
